how_to_read: Rejected rows failed automated checks: wrong host, non-200 HTTP, or no JobPosting JSON-LD in HTML. Open each link in a browser; if it is a real job, the heuristic may be too strict — set JOB_VERIFY_RELAXED=1 on one workflow run to compare, or relax verify_nvidia_job_url_detail in run_agent.py.
